evidence.notes: Seeded ProcessDefinition and ProcessNode records drive deterministic local approval submission.
Seeded ProcessInstanceWorkitem records support local approve and reject actions; missing metadata with allOrNone=false returns a failed ProcessResult.

source.content: Account approved = new Account(Name = 'Approve Me'); insert approved; Approval.ProcessSubmitRequest submitApprove = new Approval.ProcessSubmitRequest(); submitApprove.setObjectId(approved.Id); submitApprove.setSkipEntryCriteria(true); submitApprove.setNextApproverIds(new List<Id>{ '005000000000002' }); Approval.ProcessResult submittedApprove = Approval.process(submitApprove); System.assertEquals(true, submittedApprove.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals('Pending', submittedApprove.getInstanceStatus()); System.assertEquals(1, submittedApprove.getNewWorkitemIds().size()); Approval.ProcessWorkitemRequest approve = new Approval.ProcessWorkitemRequest(); approve.setWorkitemId(submittedApprove.getNewWorkitemIds().get(0)); approve.setAction('Approve'); Approval.ProcessResult approvedResult = Approval.process(approve); System.assertEquals(true, approvedResult.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals('Approved', approvedResult.getInstanceStatus()); Account rejected = new Account(Name = 'Reject Me'); insert rejected; Approval.ProcessSubmitRequest submitReject = new Approval.ProcessSubmitRequest(); submitReject.setObjectId(rejected.Id); submitReject.setSkipEntryCriteria(true); submitReject.setNextApproverIds(new List<Id>{ '005000000000002' }); Approval.ProcessResult submittedReject = Approval.process(submitReject); Approval.ProcessWorkitemRequest reject = new Approval.ProcessWorkitemRequest(); reject.setWorkitemId(submittedReject.getNewWorkitemIds().get(0)); reject.setAction('Reject'); Approval.ProcessResult rejectedResult = Approval.process(reject); System.assertEquals('Rejected', rejectedResult.getInstanceStatus()); Contact missing = new Contact(LastName = 'No Metadata'); insert missing; Approval.ProcessSubmitRequest missingRequest = new Approval.ProcessSubmitRequest(); missingRequest.setObjectId(missing.Id); Approval.ProcessResult missingResult = Approval.process(missingRequest, false); System.assertEquals(false, missingResult.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(1, missingResult.getErrors().size());
